name: MQ Technology Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司完成了Penang物业的出售及回租交易，并于2026年7月8日完成交割，随后由MPTSB向MTrustee租回该物业。除此之外，公告中未见其他业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或合约信息。
overview_en: In 2026, the company completed the disposal and leaseback of the Penang Property, with completion on 8 July 2026, after which MPTSB leased the property back from MTrustee. Apart from this, the announcements do not show any expansion, new business, reduction, or contract information for other business segments.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年主要事项为完成Penang物业的出售及回租交易。
segments.note_en: The main event this year was the completion of the disposal and leaseback of the Penang Property.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Penang物业的出售及回租交易于2026年7月8日完成，MPTSB自该日起向MTrustee租回该物业。
actions.text_en: The disposal and leaseback of the Penang Property was completed on 8 July 2026, and MPTSB leased the property back from MTrustee commencing on that date.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 出售及回租交易的买卖协议于2026年6月23日成为无条件，先决条件未满足部分获豁免并转为后续条件。
actions.text_en: The SPA for the disposal and leaseback became unconditional on 23 June 2026, with unfulfilled conditions precedent waived and treated as conditions subsequent.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 双方同意将满足先决条件的截止日期从2026年5月1日延长至2026年5月31日。
actions.text_en: Both parties agreed to extend the cut-off date for fulfilling conditions precedent from 1 May 2026 to 31 May 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 双方同意将满足先决条件的截止日期从2026年3月1日延长至2026年4月30日。
actions.text_en: Both parties agreed to extend the cut-off date for fulfilling conditions precedent from 1 March 2026 to 30 April 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 双方同意将MPTSB就PDC同意申请全额付款的到期日从2026年2月13日延长至2026年2月28日。
actions.text_en: Both parties agreed to extend the due date for MPTSB's full payment for the PDC consent application from 13 February 2026 to 28 February 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 双方同意将满足先决条件的截止日期从2026年2月1日进一步延长至2026年2月28日，并附有付款及提交文件条件。
actions.text_en: Both parties agreed to further extend the cut-off date for fulfilling conditions precedent from 1 February 2026 to 28 February 2026, subject to payment and document submission conditions.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 公司完成Penang物业的出售及回租，物业所有权转出后以租赁方式继续使用。
model_changes.text_en: The company completed the disposal and leaseback of the Penang Property, transferring ownership while continuing to use the property under a lease.
